sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface HA immunostaining at DIV16 confirmed extracellular display; no functional assay (e.g., synapse induction) reported for the tagged construct in isolation.
sites.rationale: IL1RAPL1 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein whose signal peptide spans residues 1–18 (computed); the mature extracellular domain begins at residue 19 (L). The GluR2-SP-HA vector replaces the native SP with the GluR2 SP followed by the HA tag, so the HA is deposited at the extracellular N-terminus of the mature protein. In canonical IL1RAPL1 numbering this corresponds to insert_after_residue 18 (last SP residue S) / residue_after 19 (L). Python verification confirms seq[17]='S' and seq[18]='L'. The tag is 339 residues from the TM boundary, satisfying all distance constraints. Full-length HA-IL1RAPL1 expressed in hippocampal neurons using the GluR2 signal-peptide-HA vector (PMC3221541), which places the HA tag at the extracellular mature N-terminus after SP cleavage. Neurons transfected at DIV9 and stained at DIV16 with anti-HA antibody confirmed surface display of the tagged protein.

sources.claim: ( B ) Hippocampal neurons were transfected at DIV 9 with GFP alone or with GFP and HA-IL1RAPL1, HA-IL1RAPL1▵C, HA-IL1RAPL1▵N or HA-IL1RAPL2 constructs as indicated and stained at DIV 16 for GFP and HA (only the GFP channel is shown) (scale bars = 10 μm).

HEK 293T cells were transfected with pcDNA3-YFP-IL1RAPL1 or pcDNA3-FLAG-IL1RAPL1 and pcDNA3-FLAG-Bat3, pcDNA3-myc-PLCβ1, pcDNA3-FLAG-Snap91, pcDNA3-myc-SNIP, pcDNA3-FLAG-Mcf2l, pcDNA3-FLAG-Rasal1 or pcDNA3-FLAG-PKCε (CMV promoter) using NanoJuice (Novagen).

literature_notes: L1 describes the GluR2-SP-HA vector used for IL1RAPL2 and provides mechanistic context for how the HA tag is positioned in L2; it does not add a distinct site beyond what L2 already covers for IL1RAPL1. L4 describes the same YFP/FLAG-IL1RAPL1 constructs as L3 (same paper, PMC3681934) and is therefore subsumed by Site 2. All four ledger lines converge on a single extracellular junction: the mature N-terminus after SP cleavage (insert_after_residue 18). No internal extracellular loop insertions are reported in the ledger for IL1RAPL1 or a close ortholog. No C-terminal (intracellular) tags are reported. No abrogating insertions are reported.
